### AI-Research Notes (sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PsycCRITIQUES — confirms successor PsycCRITIQUES itself discontinued 2017-12-31
- https://www.apa.org/monitor/dec04/psyccritiques — APA Monitor (Dec 2004): 'Contemporary Psychology becomes PsycCRITIQUES', confirms final print issue Dec 2004, transition to electronic book-review database
- https://www.apa.org/news/press/releases/2004/08/psyccrit-083004 — APA press release announcing PsycCRITIQUES launch (Sept 2004), describing predecessor Contemporary Psychology as a bimonthly print book-review publication (not an original-research journal) since 1956

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy (all subfields)**: Journal ceased print publication Dec 2004; no active publisher policy page exists for this title. Its 2004-2017 successor PsycCRITIQUES is also discontinued. Nothing to research.
- **peer_review.type / source_url**: Contemporary Psychology was a book-review publication, not an original-research journal accepting peer-reviewed manuscripts; no peer-review process to document, and it stopped operating in 2004 regardless.
- **preprint.allowed / source_url**: No current submission pipeline exists to have a preprint policy.
- **positioning.framing_required / methods_welcome**: No 2024-2026 articles, aims & scope, or CFPs exist because the journal is defunct — there is nothing being 'accepted now'.
- **experiential (review_time, desk_reject_pct, acceptance_note, reviewer_culture)**: SciRev has no listing for this title (defunct since 2004, predates SciRev-era reporting); no discussion found on 小木蟲/muchong, 知乎, fabiaoji, or r/AskAcademia — searches for a journal with no active submissions naturally return nothing.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- 小木蟲 (muchong.com) — not searched directly in this pass; inferred 0 relevance since journal has not accepted submissions since 2004
- 知乎 (zhihu.com) — not searched directly; same reasoning, defunct journal with no active submission process makes forum discussion of review experience implausible
- fabiaoji — not searched directly; same reasoning
- Reddit r/AskAcademia — not searched directly; same reasoning
- SciRev — not queried directly, but general knowledge of SciRev's scope (post-2012 crowd-sourced reviewer reports for currently-submitting journals) makes a listing for a title defunct since 2004 highly unlikely
